notes.availabilityPre: NOTE! On Mondays, Tuesdays and Wednesdays the space is not available for booking by default. You can still ask about availability at <1>toimitila@luuppi.fi!</1>
notes.wappu: During Wappu (13 Apr - 1 May), the space is available every day of the week.
notes.seasonalFee: A seasonal surcharge of €100 is added to prices in November and December. The rental includes 12 hours of rental time, after which additional hours can be purchased for €50 per started 4-hour block.
notes.membership: *Luuppi members with an active right to study.
